evidence.signature: format_threshold_message(metric_name: str, actual_value: float, threshold: float, unit: str="ms") -> str

evidence.docstring: Format a consistent threshold violation message.

problem: Says assert_performance_threshold 'reports the environment in the failure message'. That holds only on CI: format_threshold_message appends the platform only when is_ci_environment() is true, so a local failure names no environment. Right except on the local path.
replacement: `assert_performance_threshold` compares a measurement against it; on CI, the failure message also names the platform.
route_reason: The helper lives in tests/, not an MCP tool, so there is no example route, and no extractor reads test helpers; the module is already linked from the Overview.

problem: 'each guard' overstates it: test_performance_regression.py has slowed-on-purpose tests only for the metrics-overhead and warm find_symbol guards. The memory-footprint assertion (TestMemoryEfficiency.test_metrics_memory_footprint) has no counterpart that proves it can fail.
replacement: "slowed on purpose" tests that prove the timing guards can fail
subject: "slowed on purpose" tests that prove each guard can fail
